# KeyLight API Dashboard

> KeyLight is a lightweight, open-source API dashboard. It checks supported API account information directly in the browser: DeepSeek account balance (`/user/balance`) and available models (`/models`). The user's API key stays in page memory and is sent only to `https://api.deepseek.com`; there is no backend, proxy, Worker, database, or first-party analytics. The page loads Google AdSense for advertising.

## Key facts

- Live site: https://keylight-api-dashboard.pages.dev/
- Source code: https://github.com/longlonglink/keylight-api-dashboard
- Supported provider: DeepSeek.
- Official endpoints used: `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` and `GET https://api.deepseek.com/models`.
- The API key is never persisted by the site. Reloading the page clears it.
- The dashboard does not expose Usage history, Account ID, plan, or creation time because those are not in the current public DeepSeek API.
- Browser CORS preflight for both endpoints passed on 2026-10-26.
- The interface supports Chinese and English.
- No first-party analytics, tracking SDKs, or error-reporting services are used.
- Google AdSense is loaded for advertising under publisher `ca-pub-2541823251578668`. Google may set or read cookies and collect ad-related data under its own policies.
- This website does not process payments and has no checkout.

## Advertising and privacy

- The page loads the Google AdSense script with publisher ID `ca-pub-2541823251578668`.
- Google may set or read cookies and collect IP/device/ad-interaction data. The site's own code sets no cookies.
- The site does not intentionally send the API key, balance, or model data to ad requests.
- AdSense is a third-party script and may access the page DOM. See the privacy document for details.
- EEA/UK/Swiss consent management must be configured in the AdSense account; this project does not bundle a custom CMP.

## API Access and community

- API Access is currently advertised at 10% off the standard price.
- Telegram community: https://t.me/+mErIcVI3_R4zMDE1
- Discord community: https://discord.gg/UEZGQTTDj
- Details and any transaction are handled outside this website through those communities.
- The site does not collect payment details, issue API keys, or receive a user's API key through Telegram or Discord.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://keylight-api-dashboard.pages.dev/): connect a DeepSeek key, view the API dashboard, API Access notice, privacy notes, FAQ, and GitHub source proof.
- [Terms](https://github.com/longlonglink/keylight-api-dashboard/blob/main/TERMS.md): website and community terms.
- [Privacy](https://github.com/longlonglink/keylight-api-dashboard/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): data flow and storage.
- [Security](https://github.com/longlonglink/keylight-api-dashboard/blob/main/SECURITY.md): audit and reporting.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/longlonglink/keylight-api-dashboard/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): static deployment boundaries.

## Limitations

- KeyLight is not an official DeepSeek product, store, reseller, partner, or authorized agent.
- It cannot show data that the official API does not return.
- It cannot bypass browser CORS restrictions and will not add a proxy.
- Community offers are outside this website; verify all details before any transaction.
